title.zh: 将妇产与儿童医院的名称正式变更为Jose Fabella博士纪念医院的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Maternity and Children's Hospital to Dr. Jose Fabella Memorial Hospital
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Maternity and Children's Hospital to Dr. Jose Fabella Memorial Hospital
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Maternity and Children's Hospital thành Bệnh viện tưởng niệm Dr. Jose Fabella
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Maternity and Children's Hospital เป็นโรงพยาบาลอนุสรณ์ Dr. Jose Fabella
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Maternity and Children's Hospital menjadi Rumah Sakit Peringatan Dr. Jose Fabella
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Maternity and Children's Hospital menjadi Hospital Peringatan Dr. Jose Fabella

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5294_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Maternity and Children's Hospital in the City of Manila under the Department of Health is hereby changed to Dr. Jose Fabella Memorial Hospital.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
